game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels, tunnels among huge roots: the fairy gardener must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the elder's door.
theme: Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels: tunnels among huge roots
core_gameplay_loop: In Root Tunnels, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the elder's door. Each round, a new mana petals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the pattern_rows value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of mana petals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
